name: Cedar Park (United States)
description: Divided horizontally light blue over green, with a row of four white X shapes for the city's cedar-post and railway heritage along the division.
history: Cedar Park is a city in Williamson County, Texas. The city announced a contest for an official flag on 4 April 2016 and unveiled the winning design at its holiday tree lighting on 9 December 2016; Wikidata dates this flag from 2016 to 2019.

features.role: row of four white X shapes
